Name: HatBuffs
Author: popska0
Description:
The player will recieve a buff so long as they are wearing the hat.

Current buffs include:
* Sailor's Cap: +1 fishing
* Bowler Hat: +30 max stamina
* Straw Hat: +1 farming
* Lucky Bow: +1 luck
* Eye Patch: +1 attack
* Hard Hat: +1 mining, +1 defense
* Mushroom Cap: +1 foraging
* Dinosaur Hat: +1 luck
* Knight's Helmet: +1 defense
* Squire's Helmet: +1 defense
* Fishing Hat: +2 fishing
* Blobfish Mask: +1 fishing
* Party Hat: +1 luck
* Pirate Hat: +1 fishing, +1 luck, +1 attack
* Deluxe Pirate Hat: +1 fishing, +2 luck, +2 attack
* Copper Pan: +32 magnetism
* Small Cap: +1 speed
* Forager's Hat: +2 foraging
* Warrior Helmet: +2 attack
* Emily's Magic Hat: +1 luck, +32 magnetism
* Good ol' cap: +1 farming
* Cat Ears: +2 speed
* Wearable Dwarf Helm: +1 mining
* Chicken Mask: +50 max stamina
* Totem Mask: +1 speed
* Golden Mask: +32 magnetism
* Fedora: +32 magnetism
* Top Hat: +1 luck
* Tropiclip: +1 fishing
* Archer's Cap: +1 foraging
* Tiara: +1 speed
